set.body:
## Objective

Define independent analytic phantoms, world-landmark truth, adverse headers, degenerate patches, initialization distributions, and future subject-disjoint train/selection/test manifests. Specify scalar algebra tolerances separately from registration accuracy and timing. This is evidence design and small fixtures, not an implementation-dependent test generator.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 5, 6, 13, FA-01/02. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `docs/plans/flashalign/`
- `benchmarks/flashalign/manifests and schemas`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Hash/version fixture generators and expected invariants; prohibit generating all truth through the candidate interpolator/basis.
2. Record PRD gates, step-size sweeps, failure denominators and proposed 0.1 mm / 0.1 degree core fixture thresholds.
3. Define licenses, provenance, heldout policies and raw failure records before results are used for tuning.

## Blocking prerequisites

- None; this is an initial ready slice or planning action.

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
set.title: FA-B05: Freeze fixture, tolerance and benchmark evidence specifications
